column1: # One line per version: tag, commit, then the tag message (tab-separated).
# Versions before 0.5.0 were not tagged; CHANGELOG.md lists them. Never edit or remove a line.

column3: pcb 0.5.0: M5a checks, route quality, pcb new; first version in its own repository. cargo xtask test 65 of 65 in pcb-ci:8-local
pcb 0.5.1: parts --live fetches every schematic part; 6-layer spec warns spec-unchecked; stable hole mutation. cargo xtask test --full 64 of 64 in pcb-ci:8-local

pcb 0.6.0: ERC and circuit checks in pcb check, each finding with a place and a fix, pcb search, Preferred parts carry no fee, route widths from pcb.toml, partial keep after a worse route, a routing benchmark

pcb 0.6.1: three pcb route faults the routing benchmark showed (footprint variants routed to the wrong pads, via spacing lost in width classes, zone outlines blocking other nets). cargo xtask test --full 64 of 64 in pcb-ci:8-local before the version bump

pcb 0.7.0: the copper graph: via-current, [quality] max_decap_loop_mm and max_unreferenced_mm; usb-cc reads CC1_A5 pin names; a 0.6.1 fault fixed (zone nets ripped when pcb.toml has a critical net); plane-open warning. cargo xtask test --full 63 of 64, then the route cases again after a correction to one new case, in pcb-ci:8-local
